item.title: Antarctic orcas spotted in Bremer Bay by tour group
item.description: Antarctic orcas have been sighted in Bremer Bay by a local tour group – a rare instance of the ecotype venturing into Australian waters and potentially the first ever recorded interaction between Bremer Bay and Antarctic orcas. item.description: There’s a new chapter underway at Good Sammy’s Canning Vale headquarters.
